preconditions.description: The number of planets N must be between 1 and 100,000.
The number of Hyperspace™ highways M must be between 1 and 500,000.
The number of queries Q must be between 1 and 200,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u_i < v_i <= N for u_i, v_i in highways)
preconditions.description: Each highway must connect two distinct planets within the range of 1 to N.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a_j < b_j <= N for a_j, b_j in queries)
preconditions.description: Each query must specify two distinct planets within the range of 1 to N.

postconditions.expression: stdout == str(min_hops) for min_hops in results
postconditions.description: The output must contain the minimal number of Hyperspace™ highways for each query.
